title: Full Sentences
subtitle: Long, complex phrasing under pressure
description: Holding a cork while speaking long sentences trains your breath control, stamina, and ability to maintain articulation over time without tightening up. This mimics the demands of real conversations, speeches, and presentations.
tip: Take a full breath before each sentence and do not rush through it — let the cork remind you to keep your jaw open throughout.
phrases: I would really appreciate it if you could come over on Thursday evening
The entire presentation needs to be reviewed before the board meeting tomorrow morning
Could you please make sure that everything is ready by the time the guests arrive
We have been working on this project for several months and we are almost finished
It is important to speak clearly and confidently especially when meeting someone for the first time
The committee has decided to postpone the announcement until further information becomes available
